description: Big Beach Brewing Company is the southernmost brewery in Alabama located in the heart of Gulf Shores. The brewery features a beautiful open-air taproom with fireplace and comfortable seating. They operate a 10 barrel brewing system with six fermenters capable of producing up to 12 beers on tap at a time, specializing in craft ales including IPAs, Stouts, Cream Ales, and Belgian style beers. The taproom offers flatbreads and shareable snacks from their Taproom Table Kitchen. They carry Pensacola-made Big Jerk Soda for non-drinkers and operate on a tank-to-tap system with eight 300-gallon vessels for the freshest beer. The space is family-friendly with outdoor seating and four garage doors for coastal breeze flow.
